T1: Thermal lens (10 pts)

When an intense laser beam falls onto a semitrans-
parent plate, the transmitted light can self-focus to
a point behind the plate due to the inhomogeneous
heating of the material. This effect, known as ther-
mal lensing, is observed in materials whose index
of refraction increases with temperature, character-
ized by a positive thermo-optic coefficient 𝛾 = dd𝑇𝑛 .
